name: my-extension
description: A cross-browser extension built from the browser extension template.

scripts.build: node build.mjs chrome && node build.mjs firefox
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox && npm run package:source
scripts.sign: npm run build:firefox && npm run package:source && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --channel unlisted --upload-source-code dist/source.zip
